Looking at the diff for packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts (lines 72-91), the Salesforce integration adds a direct fetch call to 'https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token' for token refresh, but unlike other integrations modified in this PR (Google Calendar, HubSpot, Lark, Office365, Webex, Zoho, Zoom), it does NOT wrap this call with the new `refreshOAuthTokens()` function.
